title: Denial Codes and Appeal Levels in the Ostomy Supply Program
content:
In the Ostomy Supply Program a denial is worked by its denial code, and the code alone decides the route; the self-pay tier has no denials or appeals.

## Denial codes

| Code | Meaning | How it is worked |
|---|---|---|
| CO-16 | Claim lacks information | Unprocessable and never appealed; cured only by a corrected claim transmitted no later than the tier's corrected claim window in calendar days after the denial's posting date |
| CO-50 | Not medically necessary | Appealable |
| CO-151 | Frequency or quantity not supported | Appealable only when a medical record supporting the quantity, dated on or before the date of service, is on file |
| CO-197 | Authorization absent | Appealable only when an authorization grant valid on the date of service is on file |
| CO-29 | Timely filing expired | Never appealed and never billed to the customer; Larkfield writes it off with a billing correction adjustment |
| PR-204 | Not covered under the plan | Becomes the customer's responsibility only under the program's liability notice rules; otherwise Larkfield absorbs it |

Where the condition for appealing a CO-197 or CO-151 denial is not met, the denial is not appealed and is handled as a non-covered amount under the program's liability notice rules.

## Appeal levels

- **First level.** A first-level appeal may be filed no later than the tier's first-level appeal window in calendar days after the posting date of the denial it appeals, counted in calendar days from that posting date with the last day allowed.
- **Upheld decisions.** An appeal decision that upholds the denial posts as a new denial whose original posting is the appeal filing.
- **Second level.** A second-level appeal may be filed only against such an upheld first-level decision, no later than the tier's second-level appeal window in calendar days after its posting date. Where that window is 0 there is no customer-filed second level on the tier, and on the Medicare Advantage tier the plan forwards an upheld denial to the independent review entity itself.
- **One per level.** One appeal is filed per level per denial; a denial already appealed at a level is not appealed again at that level.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Case | Outcome |
|---|---|
| CO-50 denial posted on day 0, first-level window 60 days, appeal on day 60 | Timely |
| Same denial, appeal on day 61 | Out of time |
| CO-197 denial, no authorization grant valid on the date of service | Not appealed; non-covered amount |
| CO-16 denial | Corrected claim within the corrected claim window, never an appeal |
| Denial already appealed at the first level | No second first-level appeal |
